rationale: A Parkinson trial counts people with falls, but both groups received strawberry extract and the comparison was a cannabinoid drug. The strawberry-containing fruit group was null for fall admissions and the six-fruit crossover had inconclusive postural sway. Strawberry milkshake results concern mouse task engagement and do not isolate the fruit. Powder, leaf, odor and constituent studies address other preparations or endpoints. No observed direction transfers to eating raw strawberries and recurrent falls in Parkinson disease.
